3.name: Alert
3.hint: multi-functional alert, open-drain: pull it up to the VS voltage (8.2.1.2); unused, it may be left floating (6.3.1.2)

8.name: VBUS

9.name: VIN-

10.name: VIN+

2026-10-31, pin limits (schema-gaps A6, B1–B3, C1–C4): TI SBOS547C 5.1: VSDA GND − 0.3 V to 6 V regardless of VS (v_rel_max_v null), VSCL GND − 0.3 V to VS + 0.3 V (the entry's vin_rel_max_v), input current into any pin 5 mA (i_inject_max_a on SCL, A0, A1), open-drain digital output current 10 mA (SDA and Alert i_max_a); the table names no voltage limit of Alert against VS (v_rel_max_v null)
2026-10-31: Alert needs a pull-up where it is connected (SBOS547C 8.2.1.2) – an unused Alert in nc needs none

2026-10-31, Alert's limit (rules-at-scale.md, decision 15): SBOS547C has no absolute-maximum row for Alert or A0/A1; the leakage is specified for 0 V ≤ VAlert ≤ VVS (5.5) and 8.2.1.2 says 'The alert pin must to be pulled up to the VVS pin voltage' – Alert is held to VS + 0.3 V like SCL (the entry's vin_rel_max_v, LIM.v/inject, a warning); 6.3.1.2 'If the alert function is not used, the Alert pin can be left floating' – the pull-up is a need when Alert is connected
